# StartupFino

> StartupFino provides comprehensive accounting, tax, CFO, and financial planning services tailored for US startups and tech companies.

StartupFino specializes in serving startup founders and growing companies with expert financial management, compliance, and strategic planning. The platform offers industry-specific accounting solutions for SaaS, FinTech, HealthTech, E-commerce, and AgriTech businesses, combining technical expertise in GAAP, tax regulations, and startup finance with fractional and virtual CFO services.

## Key Topics

- Fractional CFO
- Virtual CFO Services
- Startup Accounting
- Tax Planning & Compliance
- Cash Flow Management
- Financial Planning & Forecasting
- Bookkeeping Services
- Fundraising & Investor Relations
- SaaS Accounting (ASC 606)
- FinTech Accounting (AML Compliance)
- HealthTech Accounting (HIPAA)
- Payroll & HR Services
- E-commerce & D2C Accounting
- GAAP & IRS Compliance
- Startup Financial Strategy

## Core Services

- [Fractional CFO Services for Startups](https://startupfino.com/us/services/fractional-cfo): StartupFino fractional CFO services for startup financial strategy
- [Virtual CFO Services for Startups](https://startupfino.com/us/services/virtual-cfo-services): StartupFino virtual CFO services with financial planning and analysis
- [Accounting and Bookkeeping Services For Small Business](https://startupfino.com/us/services/accounting-and-bookkeeping-services): StartupFino accounting and bookkeeping services for US small businesses
- [Tax Planning and Tax Compliance Services](https://startupfino.com/us/services/tax-planning-compliance): StartupFino tax planning and IRS compliance services for US startups

## Financial Management Services

- [Financial Planning and Forecasting Services](https://startupfino.com/us/services/financial-planning-and-forecasting-services): StartupFino financial planning and forecasting for startup budgeting
- [Cash Flow and Budget Management Services](https://startupfino.com/us/services/cash-flow-management-services): StartupFino cash flow management and budget planning services
- [Investor and Fundraising Services for Startups](https://startupfino.com/us/services/fundraising-for-startups): StartupFino investor relations and fundraising consulting for startups
- [HR & Payroll Services](https://startupfino.com/us/services/hr-and-payroll): StartupFino HR and payroll processing services for US startups

## Industry-Specific Accounting

- [Accounting Services for SaaS Startups](https://startupfino.com/us/industries/accounting-services-for-saas-startups): StartupFino SaaS accounting with ASC 606 revenue recognition expertise
- [Accounting Services for FinTech Startups & Companies](https://startupfino.com/us/industries/accounting-services-for-fintech-startups): StartupFino FinTech accounting with AML compliance and CPA expertise
- [Accounting Services for HealthTech Startups](https://startupfino.com/us/industries/accounting-services-for-healthtech-startups): StartupFino HealthTech accounting with HIPAA compliance and bookkeeping
- [Accounting Services for E-commerce & D2C Startups](https://startupfino.com/us/industries/accounting-services-for-ecommerce-d2c): StartupFino e-commerce accounting for Shopify, Amazon, WooCommerce
- [Accounting Services for AgriTech Startups](https://startupfino.com/us/industries/accounting-services-for-agritech-startups): StartupFino AgriTech accounting with Section 179 and Schedule F expertise
